content:
We have breaking news: Amazon's fall Prime Day deals have launched early today—the AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to one of their lowest prices ever, just $179 with shipping included.

Although fall Prime Big Deal Days aren't officially starting for another 48 hours or so, Amazon has kicked off deals early, now offering Apple's flagship AirPods Pro 3 for $179 (shipping included).

  • AirPods Pro 3 at $179 (original price $249)—one of the best prices ever

This generation of Pros carries a $249 price tag. Although we saw them drop to $199 earlier this summer, this time they've been slashed even further, a hefty $70 off, making the discounted price truly a rarity.

Apple recently launched two versions of the all-new AirPods 5 in one go: the standard version with ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) is priced at $129, while the upgraded version with a wireless charging case is priced at $129 plus an additional fee. The all-new Apple AirPods 5 offer ANC at $129, delivering outstanding bang for your buck; however, if you want the model with a wireless charging case, that'll cost you $149, and right now, for just about $30 more than the difference between the AirPods 5 and AirPods Pro 3, you can get the Pro 3 instead.

The AirPods Pro 3 deliver up to 3x improvement in active noise cancellation, longer battery life, and more advanced health features such as a built-in heart rate sensor and hearing aid functionality. For a deeper look, check out our earlier comparison feature—AirPods Pro 3 vs AirPods 5.

The AirPods 5 standard version at $129 is indeed a worthy buy, but the more feature-packed AirPods Pro 3, now selling at $179, offer a considerable discount—and this is the second time we've recorded this price point since the last time.

This price drop has come at just the right time—just a few weeks ago, Apple rolled out a series of new features for the AirPods Pro 3 alongside iOS 27. The update includes the long-awaited custom EQ feature:

Other new features also include brand-new adaptive audio control options, stronger Find My integration, and more.
